_comment: Minimal consensus override layer. A curated target overall for the handful of players where the box-score seed model clearly disagrees with broad NBA consensus - mostly stars the small-sample regression pulls down after an injury-shortened season. These are editorial ratings (our own judgment informed by public consensus/awards/role), NOT a copy of any proprietary board. Keys are player names (normalized on load, so accents/suffixes/case don't matter). Refresh each season alongside the roster dataset; keep this list as short as genuinely necessary. season: 2025-26.
